title: Saul Rejected as King

questions.question: Who did God command Saul to destroy completely?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 15:3 (ESV): “Now go and strike Amalek and devote to destruction all that they have. Do not spare them...”

questions.question: What did Saul spare contrary to God’s command?
options: King Agag and the best of the livestock
questions.correctAnswer: King Agag and the best of the livestock
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 15:9 (ESV): “But Saul and the people spared Agag and the best of the sheep and of the oxen...”

questions.question: How did Saul defend his actions to Samuel?
options: The people spared the best to sacrifice to the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: The people spared the best to sacrifice to the Lord
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 15:15 (ESV): “...for the people spared the best of the sheep and of the oxen to sacrifice to the Lord your God...”

questions.question: What famous phrase did Samuel use to rebuke Saul?
options: To obey is better than sacrifice
questions.correctAnswer: To obey is better than sacrifice
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 15:22 (ESV): “And Samuel said, ‘Has the Lord as great delight in burnt offerings... as in obeying the voice of the Lord? Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice...’”

questions.question: What happened when Samuel turned to leave Saul?
options: Saul tore the skirt of Samuel’s robe
questions.correctAnswer: Saul tore the skirt of Samuel’s robe
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 15:27 (ESV): “As Samuel turned to go away, Saul seized the skirt of his robe, and it tore.”

questions.question: Why did God want to punish Amalek?
options: For what he did to Israel when they came up out of Egypt
questions.correctAnswer: For what he did to Israel when they came up out of Egypt
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 15:2 (ESV): "I have noted what Amalek did to Israel in opposing them on the way when they came up out of Egypt."

questions.question: Who did Saul warn to depart from among the Amalekites?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 15:6 (ESV): "Saul said to the Kenites, 'Go, depart... from among the Amalekites, lest I destroy you with them.'"

questions.question: What does rebellion compare to?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 15:23 (ESV): "For rebellion is as the sin of divination..."

questions.question: What does presumption (stubbornness) compare to?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 15:23 (ESV): "...and presumption is as iniquity and idolatry."

questions.question: Who killed Agag?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 15:33 (ESV): "And Samuel hacked Agag to pieces before the LORD in Gilgal."

questions.question: Where did Saul set up a monument for himself?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 15:12 (ESV): "...Saul came to Carmel, and behold, he set up a monument for himself..."

questions.question: God is not a man, that he should ______.
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 15:29 (ESV): "And also the Glory of Israel will not lie or have regret, for he is not a man, that he should have regret."

questions.question: Why did Saul say he feared the people?
options: Because he transgressed the commandment of the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: Because he transgressed the commandment of the Lord
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 15:24 (ESV): "...I have transgressed the commandment of the LORD... because I feared the people and obeyed their voice."

questions.question: Did Samuel see Saul again until his death?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 15:35 (ESV): "And Samuel did not see Saul again until the day of his death..."

questions.question: How many men of Judah were in the army against Amalek?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 15:4 (ESV): "...200,000 men on foot, and 10,000 men of Judah."

key_verse_text: And Samuel said, “Has the LORD as great delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices, as in obeying the voice of the LORD? Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, and to listen than the fat of rams.” (ESV)
